helpItems.title: Start and end your workday
helpItems.summary: Clock in your crew, document the work, and finish the daily report.
helpItems.content: Open My Day and tap Start your day. Confirm the project and crew members who are present. At the end of the shift, tap End day, add work notes and photos, then review production and labor before submitting to the office.

helpItems.title: Review and approve a daily report
helpItems.summary: Verify field quantities, labor, exceptions, and next steps before approval.
helpItems.content: Open Daily Reports and select a report marked Needs review. Check crew hours against allocated line-item labor, verify installed quantities, resolve any unplanned-work exception, and approve. Only approved reports update project production totals.

helpItems.title: What does quantity pending mean?
helpItems.summary: Labor can be recorded now and installed quantity entered after it is measured.
helpItems.content: Quantity pending means the crew worked on the estimate line and recorded labor, but the installed amount has not been measured yet. The labor is preserved while the project completion percentage remains unchanged until quantity is added and approved.

helpItems.title: Add Pro Daily Link to your phone’s Home Screen
helpItems.summary: Open Pro Daily Link like an app from an icon on an iPhone, iPad, or Android device.
helpItems.content: iPhone or iPad: Open Pro Daily Link in Safari. Tap the Share button, scroll down, choose Add to Home Screen, confirm the name Pro Daily Link, and tap Add. If Add to Home Screen is not visible, tap Edit Actions and add it. Android: Open Pro Daily Link in Chrome. Tap the three-dot menu, choose Add to Home screen or Install app, confirm the name, and tap Add or Install. The Pro Daily Link icon will appear with your other apps. Keep the browser signed in only on a device you trust.
